component.name: VisionCLI
component.summary: Voice and screen co-assistant for developers

description.p: An AI co-assistant for developers that sees your screen and uses your computer. Ask about the file, error, UI, database table or web page in front of you, or have it do the task for you, by typing or by voice, with the AI command-line tools you already use: Claude Code or Gemini (Antigravity).

ul.li: Hold Alt and ask out loud; the answer appears in a bubble and is read aloud
Finds the real file in your project from what is on screen and answers with file and line references
Uses your computer one checked step at a time: clicks, typing, shortcuts and apps, with your approval
Points at things on your real screen and draws Mermaid diagrams in its answers
Fast browser control and read-only database questions

description.p: VisionCLI needs a signed-in Claude Code (claude) or Antigravity (agy) or Gemini CLI on your system. It runs them, and desktop tools such as tmux and xdotool, on the host.

screenshot.caption: Asking about the code on screen, answered in the bubble
Computer control: each step shown and approved

description.p: Recent projects in the Project menu and a Project picker in Settings; the Kokoro voices only show when Kokoro can run.
Meeting Notes: transcribed meetings with per-turn summaries, suggested replies, code answers and recordings. Autopilot is removed.
New logo and website, signed apt and dnf repositories, Homebrew and winget, and no repeated background-activity notice on macOS.
Kokoro voices on Windows on Arm.
Gemini in the terminal: questions with a screenshot no longer stay on "Sending".
Assistant command-line tools installed after the first run are found.
Windows preview; the Linux and Windows app share one code base.
Gemini usage in the menu, a much lighter app when idle, voice and key fixes.
